subject: Crystal Palace's Adam Wharton sent off for second yellow in 1-1 Europa League draw with Hoffenheim
title: Ten men, one point, one mystery

lines.vo: Down to ten men, Palace still got a point. How?
lines.footage: Wharton red card Palace Hoffenheim, sending-off clip

lines.vo: Adam Wharton, England midfielder, was central to Palace until minute seventy-seven.
Booked, then sent off for a second yellow, after a clash with Wouter Burger. Efficient.
lines.footage: Wharton booking and red card, slow motion; Wharton and Burger challenge

lines.vo: Alexander Prass put Hoffenheim ahead in the seventh minute. Daichi Kamada equalised in stoppage time.
lines.footage: Kamada equaliser Palace Hoffenheim, goal celebration

lines.vo: Axel Disasi had played every Europa League minute. Pierre Sage left him out. An internal decision. Very internal.
lines.footage: Pierre Sage press conference, Palace; bench shots

lines.vo: Red card, late equaliser, mystery team sheet. Palace never do quiet.
lines.footage: Palace Europa League highlights, bench shots
